== Introduction ==
* '''Website:''' http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eqlpro/
* '''Gametype:''' [[4on4]] Team Deathmatch
* '''Number of teams:''' 8
* '''Structure:''' Qualifications, Groupgames, Playoffs.
* '''Number of playoff teams:''' 4 teams were already qualified, and 8 teams signed up to qualifiy for the remaining 4 spots. 
* '''Admins:''' [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[fog]], [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Itsinen]], [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Hooraytio]]
* '''Clients allowed:'''
:: [[ezQuake]]: 1.9.3 stable (build 2572), 2.0 Stable, 2.0.1 Stable, 2.1 Alpha (build 3143)
:: [[FTE|FTE 3343]]
:: [[FodQuake|FodQuake 0.2]]
* '''Map pool:''' [[DM2]], [[DM3]], [[E1M2]]
* '''Maps to win:''' [[Best of three]] (Qualification and groupgames), [[Best of five]] (Playoffs)
